statements: CREATE TABLE "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_cents" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "low_stock_threshold" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, "serial_tracking" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("serial_tracking" IN (0, 1)), "pricing_policy" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'current', PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "inventory" ("product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("product_id"))

CREATE TABLE "inventory_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "quantity_delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "reference_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quantity_delta_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "pin_hash" TEXT NULL, "password_hash" TEXT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "failed_attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "locked_until" INTEGER NULL, "recovery_question" TEXT NULL, "recovery_answer_hash" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cashier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, bir_invoice_number INTEGER, "cash_session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES cash_sessions (id), "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "sale_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "product_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sale_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pcs', "sale_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ordinary', "batch_id" TEXT NULL, "batch_number" TEXT NULL, "extra_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "cash_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "opened_by_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "starting_cash_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expected_cash_cents" INTEGER NULL, "actual_cash_cents" INTEGER NULL, "opened_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "audit_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "details" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "sale_reversals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES sales (id), "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stock_restored" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("stock_restored" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "store_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "printer_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("printer_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "printer_transport" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lan', "printer_host" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "printer_port" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 9100, "printer_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "printer_device_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "printer_width_mm" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 80, "drawer_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("drawer_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "store_address" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "store_contact" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_header" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_footer" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "cash_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cash_sessions (id), "sale_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES sales (id), "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reference_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "bir_compliance_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "activated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "highest_invoice_number" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "grand_total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "highest_z_number" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "z_readings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "cash_session_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "generated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "generated_by_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "beginning_invoice_number" INTEGER NULL, "ending_invoice_number" INTEGER NULL, "period_sales_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reversal_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grand_total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expected_cash_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actual_cash_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE TABLE "business_feature_settings" ("feature_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("feature_id"))

CREATE TABLE "product_business_configurations" ("product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "feature_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "configuration_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("product_id", "feature_id"))

CREATE TABLE "product_lots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "batch_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "expiry_date" INTEGER NULL, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "made_orders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sale_items (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ordered', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "tank_empty_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "quantity_delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "reference_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "suppliers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "petty_cash_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cash_session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cash_sessions (id), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "price_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "user_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "old_price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "new_price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "old_cost_cents" INTEGER NULL, "new_cost_cents" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "customer_credit_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "sale_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "stock_receivings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "external_reference" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "stock_receiving_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receiving_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_receivings (id), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "batch_number" TEXT NULL, "expiry_date" INTEGER NULL, "unit_selling_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "customer_refund_obligations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "sale_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES sales (id), "layaway_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES layaways (id), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "settled_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rma_case_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "customer_refund_settlements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "obligation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customer_refund_obligations (id), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "serial_units" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "serial_number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'available', "receiving_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_receiving_items (id), "sale_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sale_items (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "inventory_layer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES inventory_layers (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "serial_sale_links" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "serial_unit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES serial_units (id), "sale_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sale_items (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "rma_cases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reference" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "sale_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sale_items (id), "receiving_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES stock_receivings (id), "receiving_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES stock_receiving_items (id), "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "supplier_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "serial_unit_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES serial_units (id), "issue_description" TEXT NOT NULL, "intake_condition" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000, "notes" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "customer_resolution" TEXT NULL, "unit_disposition" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "replacement_serial_unit_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "rma_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "case_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rma_cases (id), "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "quotations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reference" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "valid_until" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "notes" TEXT NULL, "converted_sale_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES sales (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "quotation_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "quotation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES quotations (id), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "layaways" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reference" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "sale_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES sales (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "layaway_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "layaway_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES layaways (id), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "layaway_serials" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "layaway_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES layaways (id), "serial_unit_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES serial_units (id), "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "layaway_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "layaway_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES layaways (id), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "sale_item_refunds" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rma_case_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales (id), "sale_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sale_items (id), "cash_session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES cash_sessions (id), "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cash_allocation_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "credit_allocation_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "receivable_reduction_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "obligation_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "immediate_cash_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "obligation_id" TEXT NULL, "cash_movement_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "inbound_rma_replacements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rma_case_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "receiving_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_receivings (id), "receiving_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_receiving_items (id), "serial_unit_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES serial_units (id), "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "inventory_layers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "receiving_item_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES stock_receiving_items (id), "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'receiving', "quantity_received_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quantity_remaining_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_selling_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "batch_number" TEXT NULL, "expiry_date" INTEGER NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "sale_item_inventory_allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sale_items (id), "inventory_layer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_layers (id), "serial_unit_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES serial_units (id), "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost_snapshot_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_selling_price_snapshot_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

CREATE TABLE "rma_lifecycle_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "case_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rma_cases (id), "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NULL, "expected_serial" TEXT NULL, "returned_serial" TEXT NULL, "condition" TEXT NULL, "fault_reproduced" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("fault_reproduced" IN (0, 1)), "finding" TEXT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NULL, "disposition" TEXT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NULL, "method" TEXT NULL, "serial_unit_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES serial_units (id), "related_case_id" TEXT NULL, "recipient" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cash_sessions_one_open ON cash_sessions ((1)) WHERE closed_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sales_bir_invoice_number_unique ON sales (bir_invoice_number) WHERE bir_invoice_number IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX product_lots_product_number ON product_lots (product_id, batch_number)
CREATE INDEX tank_empty_movements_product ON tank_empty_movements (product_id)
CREATE INDEX petty_cash_entries_session ON petty_cash_entries (cash_session_id)
CREATE INDEX price_history_product ON price_history (product_id)
CREATE INDEX sales_cash_session ON sales (cash_session_id)
CREATE INDEX customer_credit_entries_customer ON customer_credit_entries (customer_id)
CREATE INDEX stock_receivings_supplier ON stock_receivings (supplier_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customer_refund_rma_case ON customer_refund_obligations (rma_case_id) WHERE rma_case_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX inventory_layers_fifo ON inventory_layers (product_id, received_at, id)
CREATE INDEX sale_allocations_item ON sale_item_inventory_allocations (sale_item_id)
CREATE INDEX rma_lifecycle_case_action ON rma_lifecycle_events (case_id, action)

CREATE TRIGGER bir_state_no_decrease BEFORE UPDATE ON bir_compliance_state WHEN NEW.highest_invoice_number < OLD.highest_invoice_number OR NEW.grand_total_cents < OLD.grand_total_cents OR NEW.highest_z_number < OLD.highest_z_number BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'BIR state cannot decrease'); END
CREATE TRIGGER bir_state_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON bir_compliance_state BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'BIR state cannot be deleted'); END
CREATE TRIGGER z_readings_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON z_readings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Z-reading cannot be changed'); END
CREATE TRIGGER z_readings_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON z_readings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Z-reading cannot be deleted'); END

CREATE TRIGGER bir_sale_invoice_no_change BEFORE UPDATE OF bir_invoice_number ON sales WHEN OLD.bir_invoice_number IS NOT NULL AND NEW.bir_invoice_number IS NOT OLD.bir_invoice_number BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'BIR invoice cannot be changed'); END

CREATE TRIGGER receiving_item_source_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF receiving_id, product_id, quantity_milli, unit_cost_cents, unit_selling_price_cents, batch_number, expiry_date ON stock_receiving_items BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Receiving source cannot be changed'); END
CREATE TRIGGER receiving_item_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON stock_receiving_items BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Receiving source cannot be deleted'); END

CREATE TRIGGER inventory_layer_source_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF product_id, receiving_item_id, source, quantity_received_milli, unit_cost_cents, unit_selling_price_cents, batch_number, expiry_date, received_at ON inventory_layers BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Inventory layer source cannot be changed'); END
CREATE TRIGGER inventory_layer_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON inventory_layers BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Inventory layer cannot be deleted'); END
CREATE TRIGGER sale_allocation_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON sale_item_inventory_allocations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Sale allocation cannot be changed'); END
CREATE TRIGGER sale_allocation_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON sale_item_inventory_allocations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Sale allocation cannot be deleted'); END
